# Material Anvil discovery

The two advancements are exact generated JSON from Tinkers' Construct at
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`, under the existing MIT license and
attribution. The manifest records source URLs and SHA-256 hashes.

The source criterion intentionally accepts the fake storage block item itself,
without requiring a specific material. Craft eligibility is checked separately.
